parameters.name: ApproveId
parameters.description:
The O&M task approval ID.
> You can call the ListTodoOpsTaskApprovals operation to query this parameter.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the bastion host.

> You can invoke the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query this parameter.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host.
> For information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).
